name: Language-Learning Ritual
description: Dragon-Blooded embarking on diplomatic missions often invoke this Charm. By spending an hour meditating and listening to a native speak the language to be learned, the Exalt absorbs the knowledge of that language into her mind. The character needs some focus to meditate on, usually a cultural object related to or a book written in the language. For the Charm's duration the Dragon-Blooded is completely fluent and naturally conversant in the language, without even a trace of an accent, and may also read and write it. Once the duration expires, the knowledge fades immediately.

name: Thousand Tongues Meditation
description: The character speaking in tongues can easily speak and understand any spoken language for the Charm's duration. If speaking to beings who each speak a different language, she can understand them all and they can all understand her — but they still cannot understand each other. The maximum number of beings she may speak in tongues to at once equals her permanent Essence. This grants only the most basic communication (the equivalent of baby or pidgin speech): any social or communicative action attempted is at -4 dice, reduced by -1 for each point of permanent Essence above the minimum requirement. It works only on actual speech; sign language cannot be understood through it.

name: Poisoned Tongue Technique
description: Allows an Exalted to 'hijack' another's conversation. The effect is subtle but can be deadly. The Exalt must be able to hear the conversation to twist it, but need not be present (eavesdropping through Charms such as Voices on the Wind is permissible, though this Charm's range cannot be extended past 100 feet x the Exalt's permanent Essence). To twist a conversation, the player rolls Manipulation + Linguistics: one success sends someone away from a conversation confused, aroused, or with a sour taste in his mouth; three or more make a speaker seem heroic, amorous, ruthless, or offensive; five successes let the Dragon-Blood completely hijack the conversation, changing or amending anything said by any party. Each participant gets a reflexive Wits + Perception roll (difficulty = the Exalt's Essence) to notice the Charm; on success they realize the conversation is being manipulated and can signal so nonverbally. Use in a criminal fashion is a serious offense in the Realm and can carry a death sentence.

name: Voice of Mastery
description: With more complete mastery of the Air element, the Dragon-Blooded enhances the effect of her spoken words so they resonate with listeners, seeming more persuasive, threatening, or seductive — whatever she wishes. For the Charm's duration she adds her Essence in dice to her dice pool for any interaction involving speech (seduction, persuasion, intimidation). The Charm normally affects one listener; each additional mote doubles the number of people affected. She must be able to speak the target's language, naturally or through Charms.

name: Wind-Carried Words Technique
description: The wind carries many things, and sound can be one of them. A Terrestrial Exalt sets his words on the currents of the wind, sending them to the ear of the one he wishes to hear his message. For the base Essence cost he may send a single sentence to the ear of any other person in range; he need not speak aloud but must at least vaguely mouth the words. The difficulty of sending increases with distance: for a single mote a character can send a sentence roughly 100 feet, multiplied by his permanent Essence score; doubling the Essence spent on the Charm increases this base range by a factor of 10 (so an Essence 4 Dynast could send 400 feet for 1 mote, 4,000 feet for 2, 40,000 for 3). The sender must have a general sense of the target's direction but need not see her. This Charm is essential to the Realm's military operations.

name: Voices on the Wind
description: Some Dynasts of Air extend their senses through the air to listen to what people far away say. The further away a character wants to eavesdrop, the more expensive the Charm: for the base cost an Air-aspected Dragon-Blood can clearly hear normal speech from 100 feet away, multiplied by permanent Essence, and doubling the Essence spent multiplies that base range by 10. He also gets a general sense of the target's direction. Limitations: he must specify a single person to spy upon (he cannot 'listen for people plotting against me' — at most he lists suspects and eavesdrops on them one by one); he cannot hear anything spoken in an airtight chamber (many powerful Dynasts build such chambers to defeat this Charm); and listening from far away demands total concentration, so he can perform no other action while listening.

name: With One Mind
description: A Dynast of Air enables a group of people to know each other's surface thoughts: what one sees, all the others see, and tactical decisions become an open book to allies. A group fighting with With One Mind shows uncanny coordination, trading off opponents without a hitch. For each 2 motes spent, the recipients gain one dot each of Wits, Perception, and Melee, up to the Dragon-Blooded's own Linguistics rating. Any linked character may parry, or abort to parry, an attack against any other member he is close enough to plausibly reach; if multiple linked characters parry a given attack, subtract all their successes from the attack roll. The initiator may link as many people as she has dots of Essence, but all must share the same level of linkage, she must pay to enhance each of them (including herself), and no benefit is gained unless at least two people are linked. Linked characters must have trained together for at least a week and spend a turn on a shared breathing exercise and war-shout to initiate the link, and must stay within 50 feet x the highest Essence of the participants; if any moves beyond that range the link breaks and the Charm ends. It also has non-combat uses, allowing instantaneous nonverbal communication between the linked group for the duration.

name: Cipher Missive
description: In the matters of governance, commerce and military action that are the focus of Dynastic society, there is always sensitive material that must be communicated and, thus, a need for secure methods to encrypt such material. This Charm allows an Exalted scribe to augment her knowledge of the structure of language and to use that augmented knowledge to create a preternaturally complex cipher. The scribing character spends the required amount of time writing the document, which can be no longer that her Essence in pages, and her player rolls Intelligence + Linguistics to determine the total number of accumulated successes needed to decipher the document. Each deciphering roll is an Intelligence + Linguistics roll with a difficulty equal to the permanent Essence of the character using Cipher Missive, and represents a number of days spent codebreaking equal to the Essence of the character who created the cipher. Remember that successes only accumulate against the encoding character's Intelligence + Linguistics roll if the character attempting to decrypt the missive exceeds the base difficulty of the roll (i.e., the Essence of the character who used this Charm). The character using this Charm may name a number of individuals up to a maximum of twice his Essence rating who can freely read the ciphered document, or he may name a limited, specific class of people who may freely read the document. For example, a character could make a ciphered document that could only be read freely by magistrates or only by officers in the Vermilion Legion.

name: Craft Icon
description: In a society as complex and often frenetic as that of the Realm, the ability to smoothly convey a complex block of information or directives to others is not only a great boon, it is practically a necessity. This Charm allows for the design of sigils and pictograms that illustrate a dense collection of data such as directions to a location or instructions for the assembly of a complex device and does so in a simple iconographic style that can be understood by anyone, regardless of the languages they speak. The player of the Dragon-Blood using this Charm rolls Manipulation + Linguistics at a difficulty of 2. Successes indicate the level of complexity encoded into the pictogram, with each success over the difficulty providing the equivalent of one minute's worth of careful instruction. The icons created by the use of this Charm can be drawn, carved or in any media the creator wishes to use. The channeling of Essence into the creation of an icon is vital to its depiction, and it cannot be reliably reproduced without another application of Craft Icon. Any mundane reproduction of a pictogram created with this Charm will, at best, serve only as well as if the Dragon-Blood's player had rolled the minimum two successes. Icons created with this Charm are two square inches in size per success.

name: Speech Without Words
description: Cipher Missive The ability to silently convey complex information allows for a much greater degree of coordination among allies when they find themselves in circumstances where speech would be a detriment, such as during close-range martial conflicts or ambushes most obviously (but not exclusively). The use of this Charm allows a Dragon-Blood and one additional ally per mote of Essence spent (to a maximum of the Exalt's Wits + Linguistics) to silently communicate using hand gestures and signals. The gestures required to make use of this Charm are subtle and not enough to give away a user's position or generate a great amount of sound. Users of this Charm are obviously communicating with one another if they do so openly, however, making this Charm's usefulness in social settings somewhat limited.

name: Favored Quill Mastery
description: Charms Dragon-Blooded culture demands excellence from its constituents in a variety of fields of endeavor, making a broad education the norm. With so many responsibilities and areas of study open to them as a culture, however, specialists are needed for esoteric, demanding or vital disciplines. Linguistic- and communication-oriented tasks are no exception to this, as not every Dragon-Blood can be a master cipher, speechwriter and poet all at once. An Exalt using this Charm may buy his dots in a Linguistics specialty as automatic successes, rolling the remainder of his pool as normal. The automatic successes may only be added to rolls involving the specialty in question.
